title: Simulation flowsheet of an ammonia synthesis process from natural gas / simulation flowsheet of an ammonia synthesis reactor
description: ProSim document section 1.2 contains two titled flowsheets (p.6 natural-gas-to-ammonia process, p.7 ammonia synthesis reactor). Heat exchange between process streams and steam generation by a boiler are simulated; utility networks and expander-compressor couplings are not simulated.
